entries.what: The Heatmap Layer in the Maps JavaScript API is decommissioned, as of release 3.65.1c on 2026-05-20. A loader that pins an older version may keep it for as long as that version is served.

source.quote: The Heatmap Layer functionality in the Maps JavaScript API is now decommissioned.

lookFor: google.maps.visualization, in code or a type

The visualization library asked for by importLibrary, useMapsLibrary, a libraries list given to a Maps loader, or libraries= on the Maps script URL. Not a HeatmapLayer from deck.gl or any other library.
entries.replacement: The deprecations page suggests a third-party library integration such as deck.gl, which has its own HeatmapLayer.
requires: deck.gl is a new dependency with its own layer API and an overlay on the map, so this is a rewrite of the layer rather than a rename. Also drop visualization from the libraries the loader asks for.
